# jQuery

Pinned full production build: **4.1.0** (includes AJAX and effects).

Source: https://code.jquery.com/jquery-4.1.0.min.js

SHA-256: `86346f3e414b3b52466453171abcdda46e9396c1c3ca3a783d07aa2d645c3339`

The original license banner and upstream `LICENSE.txt` are retained. Django
serves this file locally; visitors do not contact a CDN to load jQuery.

To update, download the official full build, check its version and digest, update
the filename and base template, then run the dashboard browser checks.
